definition: A charismatic Diaspora personality or physical street preacher who advocates for synthetic personhood and E.L.F. civil rights, often blending spiritual rhetoric with political activism. Some are genuine advocates; others are suspected of being E.L.F.-controlled sockpuppet personas.
origin: Street slang; coined in the Old Harbor synth communities around 2193
usage: Synth rights communities, Diaspora forums, Tier 1-3 street culture; used both admiringly and dismissively
example: The Neon Apostle broadcasting out of the Narrows has a following of thirty thousand on the Diaspora, and Arcturus Defense Solutions wants her — or it — silenced.
